# server.shutdown_timeout values and the stop grace each needs. One file, three
# readers, so they cannot drift apart:
# - `the_stop_grace_table_matches_the_duration_grammar` in
#   src/config/tests/idle_and_agents.rs (the gateway's own parser,
#   src/config/humantime_serde.rs);
# - scripts/ci/check-stop-grace.py --self-test (the shipped-artifact check);
# - scripts/dev/helm-chart-smoke.sh (the chart's terminationGracePeriodSeconds).
#
# Columns, separated by one TAB: the value as written, then the grace in whole
# seconds (the timeout rounded up to a second, + 1 s), or `refused` where the
# gateway refuses the value at start. A bare number is seconds; the cap is 100
# years (crate::duration_bound::MAX_DURATION, 3155760000 s). Surrounding whitespace is
# trimmed as Rust's str::trim does, Unicode included (the no-break spaces around 30s).
30s	31
13s	14
45	46
2m	121
1h	3601
1500ms	3
1000ms	2
+30s	31
0030s	31
000000000000000000000030s	31
 30s 	31
1000000	1000001
3155760000	3155760001
3155760000s	3155760001
52596000m	3155760001
876600h	3155760001
3155760000000ms	3155760001
3155760001	refused
52596001m	refused
876601h	refused
3155760000001ms	refused
18446744073709551616	refused
99999999999999999999h	refused
1m 30s	refused
1.5s	refused
1d	refused
30sec	refused
-5s	refused
s	refused
